issues.where: the glass rim and upper-right of the sphere
issues.what: -b carries a thick bright white-blue edge highlight all around the sphere and a hard white arc reflection in the upper-right, while -a's glass is thin and dark with only soft warm glints; the sphere in -b reads as heavy blown glass next to -a's delicate one
issues.fix: thin the rim highlight to a faint warm edge and soften the upper-right arc into a low, warm glint

issues.where: the glass rim and the crown of the sphere
issues.what: same hard bright rim and white arc as set A, plus a ring-shaped bubble artifact sitting on top of the glass that has no counterpart in -a
issues.fix: remove the ring artifact on the crown and pull the rim and arc reflections down to -a's faint warm level

issues.what: -a's tree is a sparse, gnarled dead tree with a thick twisted dark trunk and open branches; -b's crown is dense with fine twigs and packed glowing points, reading as a fuller, different tree
issues.fix: thin the crown, restore the heavy twisted trunk silhouette, and thin out the lit points

issues.where: the ground inside the globe, below the cottage and pond (crops 2 and 5)
issues.what: -b's interior floor is a flat, saturated neon-green slab with a hard top edge and the pond shrank to a small dark patch; -a's floor is soft, textured, misty green terrain with a readable pond
issues.fix: desaturate and texture the ground, soften its edge, and give the pond back its size and sheen

issues.where: the embers in the liquid (crops 1 and 3)
issues.what: -b's particles are sparser, dimmer and cooler, so the inside of the globe reads darker and loses the dense warm sparkle that fills -a
issues.fix: add embers back to -a's density and warm their colour and brightness

issues.where: the storm inside the globe (crops 1, 2 and 3)
issues.what: -a's just-shaken swirl is long, silky and layered with leaf discs, letting the miniature read through it; -b's streaks are short and scratchy under a milky green haze that hides the scene more evenly and reads grittier
issues.fix: lengthen and layer the streaks, cut the green opacity, and restore the spiral flow

issues.where: the base from rim to foot (crops 4, 5 and 6)
issues.what: -b's base is flatter and built of evenly stacked horizontal twigs with much longer, thicker wax drips; -a's base is taller, a chaotic weave of thorns with short drips, and its pumpkins sit nested in the thorns rather than lined up on the front
issues.fix: rebuild the weave taller and wilder, shorten the wax drips, and nestle the pumpkins back into the branches

issues.where: the base from rim to foot (crops 4, 5 and 6)
issues.what: same mismatch as set A: flattened stacked-twig construction and oversized wax drips against -a's tall thorn weave
issues.fix: match -a's taller, tangled thorn structure and shorter drips

issues.where: the line where the base meets the surface, and the mirror image (crop 6)
issues.what: -b's black surface reflection is muddier and a pale rocky patch breaks the mirror at the front; -a shows a clean dark mirror of the pumpkins and leaves
issues.fix: darken and polish the surface and remove the pale patch

issues.where: the surface reflection below the base (crop 6)
issues.what: mirror image weaker than -a's crisp reflection of the pumpkin glow and scattered leaves
